<h3 data-id="heading-1">0.好久不见</h3>
<p>各位早上、中午、晚上好！我是鸽子王何贤，距离上次更新已时隔两月，在此深表歉意。除近期本职工作较忙外，还有一些特殊原因导致鸽了这么久：</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/fc24ee1650c343c0bef1ae824ad3d19f~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=69HM1eq7YV0q%2FlxS0GlAcm63XSc%3D" alt="01.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><code>Blender mcp</code> 的作者联系我说有米奇妙妙小工具，我说这太好了，一来二去可能就耽误了本次发文章的时间，还是很对不起运营小哥的，在这说一声对不起。但请允许我将功补过——在完成<code>Beta</code>版后第一时间与大家分享。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">1.Page 预览</h3>
<p>话说老何长时间被电子 ED 困扰，没什么游戏好玩，又不想干农活，于是就在 <code>Steam</code> 上找起了游戏。鼠标在夏日促销页面上不断翻动，商品琳琅满目但都提不起兴趣。</p>
<p>不知不觉就就找到了一款城建类卡通风游戏 《<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fstore.steampowered.com%2Fapp%2F2198070%2F_Cardboard_Town%2F%3Fl%3Dschinese" target="_blank" title="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2198070/_Cardboard_Town/?l=schinese" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">卡牌城镇Cardboard Town</a>》</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/8903fba8b2da4470860d8ebba27e2ad1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=%2Bb1QpBOuNAmdMv9VABkSU8yN8C4%3D" alt="02.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>老何平时的游戏风格都是战斗爽，从来没玩过城建游戏哇！一下子就给陷进去了。后面两天老何天天就是白天看攻略，晚上通宵当市长。久而久之老何就连白天都想着能不能开一把。但是公司人多眼杂，当众玩游戏只怕游戏10点开的，12点就开始办离职申请了。但是规矩是死的，人是活的。上班玩游戏的胆子没有，但是...借着敲代码的名义开发一个游戏来玩的胆子大大的有。</p>
<p>因此，这个项目就在老板的眼皮底下诞生了。
由此，在老板眼皮底下诞生了基于<code>Three.js+Vue</code>的城建游戏——《CubeCity》。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-3">1.1 粗略概览(平台限制 画质需要压缩)</h4>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/3e08c3063e7f49a4a03fa6143638c426~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=%2BEJT5VV3N%2FLKZrusy1s0VkniMaA%3D" alt="01.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">1.2 大致功能概览</h4>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/cf2848b465a34075a59dbc5f719cfb82~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=%2BrBvy3aZ0KnXoToF%2BCwTBBaQWYg%3D" alt="04.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">1.3 玩法介绍</h4>
<p>游戏主要围绕四种操作模式展开</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>🏗️ 建造模式 (BUILD):</strong>
<ul>
<li>快捷键 <strong>B</strong></li>
<li>从左侧面板选择你想要的建筑。</li>
<li>在地图上的可用地皮上点击即可放置建筑，实时预览模型和高亮提示让操作更直观。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/4dac657329fd4a4da9d704524cbc081f~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=1mvXhPMMSMRmanEQsdo609tZLvk%3D" alt="02.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>🔍 选择模式 (SELECT):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>快捷键 <strong>S</strong></li>
<li>点击建筑查看详细信息，如这一级的产出 &amp; 污染，以及下一级的产出 &amp; 污染等。</li>
<li>满足条件时可对建筑进行升级，提升其功能和产出。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ddf2af8017c646078e8b0b0326647a72~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=1raCU3AW66O%2BHpGqBtwF5R4hFdw%3D" alt="03.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>🚚 搬迁模式 (RELOCATE):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>快捷键 <strong>R</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>选中一个已建好的建筑，然后点击一个空地，即可轻松完成搬迁。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>在BUILD 放置后按 R 键，可以旋转建筑以适应你的城市布局。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/c9d7a1c1c2594558b21b6be6b093abf8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=immIolC49xUAml%2FZs2WdqkjidMs%3D" alt="04.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>💣 拆除模式 (DEMOLISH):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>快捷键 <strong>D</strong></li>
<li>切换到此模式，点击不再需要的建筑即可将其拆除。</li>
<li>拆除建筑会返还部分建造成本。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/6ce1f4afe2e143dabe0b389efac2025c~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=S0jpB7Ni6jsV2ADTovS3bZZkhqQ%3D" alt="05.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-6">1.4 建筑相互作用</h4>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/2b3faa5eb9a44e72aab928d0f93b70d8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=kFi%2Fq7mEzKc3N1WHSzUIAV0Bg2I%3D" alt="05.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b971c35d9bfc420f9bb82fa3f1f0f8b5~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=%2FpPcHSX2X0d5VFPaasOZUC0JJ9A%3D" alt="06.gif" loading="lazy"></p>

<h4 data-id="heading-7">Threejs 转发贴</h4>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/1a068523c11f4bb89ad5608d27d7e965~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=h9V6Kayd50p9%2BAX8OTVDv0DiVzE%3D" alt="06.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-8"><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fhexian37496562%2Fstatus%2F1952198041148264548" target="_blank" title="https://x.com/hexian37496562/status/1952198041148264548" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">原贴 &amp; 地址</a></h4>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e335253511e041449307d7be9497ec55~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=Ppb2bYRicJGTetH5VcZAfIqEF2g%3D" alt="07.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">2.游戏基建结构</h3>
<p><strong><code>注意，本项目纯属整活项目！开发游戏项目请使用游戏引擎！！！</code></strong></p>
<p><strong><code>注意，本项目纯属整活项目！开发游戏项目请使用游戏引擎！！！</code></strong></p>
<p><strong><code>注意，本项目纯属整活项目！开发游戏项目请使用游戏引擎！！！</code></strong></p>
<p>在 <a href="https://juejin.cn/post/7509880859307835433" target="_blank" title="https://juejin.cn/post/7509880859307835433">😲我又写出了被 Three.js 官推转发的项目？！🥳🥳(源码分享)</a> 中曾提到过<a href="https://juejin.cn/post/7509880859307835433#heading-7" target="_blank" title="https://juejin.cn/post/7509880859307835433#heading-7">游戏开发三要素</a></p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/8bb71c735cac4927a417153c4d228621~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=tVeCLydzHc0N2%2BOH%2FYKcLbX0%2BzY%3D" alt="Snipaste_2025-08-16_16-06-12.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>简单来说</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Scene</strong> 负责"演什么" - 处理3D模型、光照、物理效果</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>UI</strong> 负责"怎么看" - 控制分数显示、菜单系统</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Metadata</strong> 负责"怎么玩" - 管理游戏状态、得分规则、角色属性</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>接下来我也会从这三个方面大致的介绍项目运行的基本原理，但想在一篇文章内从头到尾解释清楚项目中所有的细节怎么实现不太现实。不过<strong>如果这篇文章点赞+收藏 超过 <code>100</code>。我会为这个项目单开一个栏目，从 需求分析、项目规划、美工素材处理、背景音乐生成、代码撰写、项目管理到最后的部署从头到尾解释一遍。谢谢大家支持。</strong></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">2.1 元数据体系与规划 (Metadata)</h4>
<p>核心思想是把“城市事实”与“三维表现”彻底解耦：<strong>一切以 Pinia 的 metadata 为“单一事实源（Single Source of Truth）”，三维场景只是其投影和可视化。</strong> 常有人调侃游戏玩家：“真是好笑，一堆数据当宝？！” 事实确实如此。不同的表现形式基于统一的数据，比如这个项目。若使用 2D 界面显示数据，也一样可以玩（例如在地图格子上玩简易城建游戏）：</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d4f992e87ae64937a50837072ba6348d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=4%2FiJW2Fl7YgIhFe%2FiXu388UKwYs%3D" alt="09.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>那么接下来我来介绍一下<code>Metadata</code>是如何规划的，有一点我们绝对不能忘：<strong>任何业务逻辑必须“元数据优先，三维从属”。</strong></p>
<h5 data-id="heading-11">2.1.1 网格与坐标约定</h5>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/cc0450556ed54393bab838afb36bbdf6~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=Wp8Wih2IlhqfVXx%2BS4ai48zHcuA%3D" alt="08.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>《CubeCity》的主要玩法是用户在一块 17×17 的地皮上建造、销毁、迁移、升级建筑，并随着游戏时间增加金币。城市采用 17×17 的离散网格（默认 SIZE = 17），每个格子是一个 Tile（地皮）。因此，我在 <code>Store（Pinia）</code> 中定义的初始城市就是一个 <code>17*17</code> 的二维数组。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> useGameState = <span class="hljs-title function_">defineStore</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'gameState'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">state</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> ({
    <span class="hljs-attr">metadata</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">from</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">length</span>: <span class="hljs-number">17</span> }, <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">_</span> =&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">from</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">length</span>: <span class="hljs-number">17</span> }, <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">_</span> =&gt;</span> ({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'grass'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">building</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">direction</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
      }))),
    <span class="hljs-attr">currentMode</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'build'</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">//当前玩家选择的模式</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">selectedBuilding</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">//当前玩家选择的地皮</span>
  }),
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-12">2.1.2 单格 Tile 的数据模型</h5>
<p>当某块地皮上存在建筑时，则会在对应下标的元数据中填入相应的建筑信息</p>
<p><em>在后续我会提到游戏种各个类型建筑都具体起到哪些作用，在这里仅简单介绍一下存放存档时的对象</em></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-json" lang="json"><span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"type"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"ground"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>            <span class="hljs-comment">// 地形：grass/ground/road ...</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"building"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"factory"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>       <span class="hljs-comment">// 建筑类型 如 民宿、工厂、商店</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"direction"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>              <span class="hljs-comment">// 朝向：0/1/2/3（右/下/左/上）</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"level"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-number">1</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>                  <span class="hljs-comment">// 建筑等级</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"detail"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>                  <span class="hljs-comment">// 后续会提到具体各项 props</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"coinOutput"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-number">70</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"powerUsage"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-number">40</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"pollution"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-number">22</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"population"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-number">20</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"category"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"industrial"</span>	<span class="hljs-comment">// 建筑类别 主要分三大类 住房 工业 商业</span>
  <span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"outputFactor"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-number">1</span>            <span class="hljs-comment">// 产出系数（相互作用或全局事件影响）</span>
<span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> useGameState = <span class="hljs-title function_">defineStore</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'gameState'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ....</span>
    
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 更新 metadata 地皮的 action</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">action</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">setTile</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x, y, patch</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">assign</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">metadata</span>[x][y], patch)
    },
    <span class="hljs-title function_">updateTile</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x, y, patch</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">assign</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">metadata</span>[x][y], patch)
    },
    <span class="hljs-title function_">getTile</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x, y</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">metadata</span>?.[x]?.[y] || <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
    },
  }
})
</code></pre>
<p>建造模式点击地皮时<code>action</code>：</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/dfc9aa6b3f594ce5a3bd9ec21fd2adca~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=k7dWVEzq0AbWOwbvJZggYtP1bZc%3D" alt="08.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这样做有一些好处：比如<strong>当我们在做聚合计算（收入/人口/电力/污染)时可直接遍历整个<code>metadata</code>，简化心智模型。</strong></p>
<p>计算每日总收入的<code>getters</code></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> useGameState = <span class="hljs-title function_">defineStore</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'gameState'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">state</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> ({
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 核心游戏状态</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">metadata</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">from</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">length</span>: <span class="hljs-number">17</span> }, <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">_</span> =&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">from</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">length</span>: <span class="hljs-number">17</span> }, <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">_</span> =&gt;</span> ({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'grass'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">building</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">direction</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
      }))),
    <span class="hljs-attr">currentMode</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'build'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">selectedBuilding</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>,
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 游戏时间和经济</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">gameDay</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">credits</span>: <span class="hljs-number">3000</span>,
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其余同上</span>
  }),
  <span class="hljs-attr">getters</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/**
     * 计算每日总收入（直接使用metadata中的detail，大幅提升性能）
     * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">object</span>} <span class="hljs-variable">state</span> - 游戏状态
     * <span class="hljs-doctag">@returns</span> {<span class="hljs-type">number</span>} 总收入
     */</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">dailyIncome</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> totalIncome = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
      state.<span class="hljs-property">metadata</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">row, x</span>) =&gt;</span> {
        row.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">tile, y</span>) =&gt;</span> {
		<span class="hljs-comment">//遍历有建筑的地皮进行汇总计算</span>
          <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (tile.<span class="hljs-property">building</span> &amp;&amp; tile.<span class="hljs-property">detail</span>) {
            <span class="hljs-comment">// 使用高效函数：自动判断是否需要相互作用计算(后面会讲到)</span>
            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> income = <span class="hljs-title function_">getEffectiveBuildingValue</span>(state, x, y, <span class="hljs-string">'coinOutput'</span>)
            totalIncome += income
          }
        })
      })

      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> totalIncome
    },
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其余同上</span>
  }
</code></pre>
<p>假设现实中每<code>5S</code>就类比游戏世界的一天，实现金币增加功能：定时器定时 + 相关逻辑即可：</p>
<ul>
<li>构建下一天逻辑，有关<code>Metadata</code>时间的逻辑都在此 <code>action</code>中执行</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> useGameState = <span class="hljs-title function_">defineStore</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'gameState'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 省略...</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">getters</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/**
     * 计算每日总收入（直接使用metadata中的detail，大幅提升性能）
     * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">object</span>} <span class="hljs-variable">state</span> - 游戏状态
     * <span class="hljs-doctag">@returns</span> {<span class="hljs-type">number</span>} 总收入
     */</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">dailyIncome</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">state</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> totalIncome = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
      state.<span class="hljs-property">metadata</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">row, x</span>) =&gt;</span> {
        row.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">tile, y</span>) =&gt;</span> {
		<span class="hljs-comment">//遍历有建筑的地皮进行汇总计算</span>
          <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (tile.<span class="hljs-property">building</span> &amp;&amp; tile.<span class="hljs-property">detail</span>) {
            <span class="hljs-comment">// 使用高效函数：自动判断是否需要相互作用计算(后面会讲到)</span>
            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> income = <span class="hljs-title function_">getEffectiveBuildingValue</span>(state, x, y, <span class="hljs-string">'coinOutput'</span>)
            totalIncome += income
          }
        })
      })

      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> totalIncome
    },
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其余同上</span>
  },
  <span class="hljs-attr">action</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/**
     * 进入下一天，更新金币和稳定度
     */</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">nextDay</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 经济系统更新</span>
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">credits</span> += <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">dailyIncome</span>
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">gameDay</span>++
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其余同上</span>
    },
  }
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-13">2.1.3 从元数据到三维</h5>
<p><strong>vite-three-js 框架结构速览（给没接触过的同学）</strong></p>
<p>最先开始为了防止您没有接触过任何我之前写过的项目，我将向您展示我是如何组织我的代码（师承<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fthreejs-journey.com%2Flessons%2Fcode-structuring-for-bigger-projects%23compatibility" target="_blank" title="https://threejs-journey.com/lessons/code-structuring-for-bigger-projects#compatibility" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Bruno Simon</a> )，你可以把他看做一份<code>High Level View</code>。</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>核心思想</strong>：以 Experience 单例为中心，统一管理 Three.js 场景、渲染器、相机、资源加载、时间、尺寸、交互、调试等。任何 3D 组件都通过 new Experience() 获取全局依赖，保持解耦与一致风格。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Experience</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./experience.js'</span> 

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Your3DComponent</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 获取 Experience 单例实例</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Experience</span>()

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 通过 experience 实例访问核心组件和工具 </span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>             <span class="hljs-comment">// THREE.Scene 实例</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resources</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resources</span>     <span class="hljs-comment">// 资源加载器实例 (Resources)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-property">instance</span>  <span class="hljs-comment">// THREE.Camera 实例 (透视或正交)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">renderer</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">renderer</span>.<span class="hljs-property">instance</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// THREE.WebGLRenderer 实例</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">time</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">time</span>               <span class="hljs-comment">// 时间控制器实例 (Time)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">sizes</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">sizes</span>             <span class="hljs-comment">// 尺寸管理器实例 (Sizes)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">iMouse</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">iMouse</span>           <span class="hljs-comment">// 鼠标跟踪器实例 (IMouse)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">debug</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">debug</span>             <span class="hljs-comment">// 调试 UI 实例 (Debug)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">physics</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">physics</span>         <span class="hljs-comment">// 物理世界实例 (PhysicsWorld)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">stats</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">stats</span>             <span class="hljs-comment">//性能监控实例 (Stats)</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>           <span class="hljs-comment">// HTML Canvas 元素</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其他可能需要的实例</span>
  }

	<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
		<span class="hljs-comment">// 如果需要逐帧更新，从 this.experience.time 取时间对象</span>
	}

	<span class="hljs-title function_">resize</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
		<span class="hljs-comment">// 如果需要响应尺寸变化</span>
	}
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Vue 与 Three.js 通信（解耦）</strong></p>
<p>全局状态用 Pinia（如模式、选中类型），即时事件用 mitt (或者任何一类具有发布者订阅者模式的功能函数）。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>如果您对整体项目没有较完整的概念，这边也建议您去阅读 <a href="https://juejin.cn/post/7509880859307835433" target="_blank" title="https://juejin.cn/post/7509880859307835433">😲我又写出了被 Three.js 官推转发的项目？！🥳🥳(源码分享)</a>。</p>
<p>把<code>Metadata</code>用 <code>3D</code>场景呈现出来的流程可分为四步：Pinia 元数据读取 → City 按网格实例化 → Tile 生成地形与挂载建筑 → Building 初始化模型与状态效果。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Pinia 是事实源：用于提供 <code>Metadata</code> 中的具体信息，如 type/building/direction/level/detail。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>City 是投影器：按网格遍历 metadata，生成 Tile 并挂到 city.root。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Tile 是地皮容器：根据 type 决定草地/地面层显隐；根据 building/level/direction 实例化建筑。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Building 是可视实体：加载 GLTF 或占位体，按 direction 确定建筑方向。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/bfe4de99870646b093e058e3a23ab6aa~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=dyHoTZ64IAV6zyAPgAcyXcP3PmE%3D" alt="11.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>World.js: 管理 City 类的挂载和更新</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">World</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Experience</span>()	<span class="hljs-comment">//</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resources</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resources</span>

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resources</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'ready'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 实例化城市地皮</span>
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">city</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">City</span>()
    })
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 若 city 有 update 行为可调用</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">city</span> &amp;&amp; <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">city</span>.<span class="hljs-property">update</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">city</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>()
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>City.js: 从 Pinia 读取并实例化网格地皮（Tile）</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useGameState } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/stores/useGameState.js'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">City</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Experience</span>()
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resources</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resources</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化地皮</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">initTiles</span>()

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 调试面板</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">debug</span>.<span class="hljs-property">active</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">debugInit</span>()
    }
  }
<span class="hljs-comment">//初始化 17x17 地皮，分布在 XOZ 平面 -8~+8</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">initTiles</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> gameState = <span class="hljs-title function_">useGameState</span>()
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { metadata } = <span class="hljs-title function_">storeToRefs</span>(gameState)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> meta = metadata.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> x = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; x &lt; <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">size</span>; x++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> row = []
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> y = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; y &lt; <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">size</span>; y++) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tileMeta = meta[x]?.[y] || { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'grass'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">building</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> }
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tile = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Tile</span>(x, y, {
          <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">type</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">building</span>: tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">building</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">direction</span>: tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">direction</span> !== <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span> ? tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">direction</span> : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">level</span>: tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">level</span> !== <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span> ? tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">level</span> : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
        })
        row.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(tile)
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">root</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(tile)
      }
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">meshes</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(row)
    }
  }
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Tile.js 负责呈现地皮与建筑的模型</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// Tile 类，代表单个地皮格子，继承 SimObject (具体 SimObject作用在后面会说，现在只需要把他等同于 Object3D 类即可)</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Tile</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_ inherited__">SimObject</span> {
     <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x, y, { type = <span class="hljs-string">'grass'</span>, building = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>, direction = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, level = <span class="hljs-number">0</span> } = {}</span>) {

            <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">BoxGeometry</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.98</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.98</span>),
            <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">MeshStandardMaterial</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#579649'</span> }),
          )
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">grassMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">grassMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.98</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.98</span>)
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">grassMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">grassMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.name}</span>-grass`</span>
        
        <span class="hljs-comment">//加载平地资源</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> groundResource = resources.<span class="hljs-property">items</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ground</span> ? resources.<span class="hljs-property">items</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ground</span> : <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groundMesh</span> = groundResource
          ? <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">initMeshFromResource</span>(groundResource)
          : <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Mesh</span>(

            <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">MeshStandardMaterial</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#a89984'</span> }),

        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groundMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.01</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 稍微高于 grass，避免 z-fighting</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groundMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.98</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.98</span>)
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groundMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>

        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groundMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visible</span> = (type === <span class="hljs-string">'ground'</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始是否显示</span>
         
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">grassMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groundMesh</span>)
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">grassMesh</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">//层级为 Tile--&gt; grassMesh（groundMesh） --&gt; building</span>
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果有建筑，加载建筑实例</span>
