        }
          <span class="hljs-comment">// 切换地皮类型（实际上是控制 ground mesh 的显示与隐藏）</span>
          <span class="hljs-title function_">setType</span>(<span class="hljs-params">type</span>) {
            <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> = type
            <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">groundMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visible</span> = (type === <span class="hljs-string">'ground'</span>)
          }

          <span class="hljs-comment">// 创建并添加建筑实例</span>
          <span class="hljs-title function_">setBuilding</span>(<span class="hljs-params">type, level = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, direction = <span class="hljs-number">0</span></span>) {
            <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeBuilding</span>()
            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buildingData = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILDING_DATA</span>[type]
            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> levelData = buildingData.<span class="hljs-property">levels</span>[level]
            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> options = { buildingData, levelData, <span class="hljs-attr">position</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> } }
            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buildingInstance = <span class="hljs-title function_">createBuilding</span>(type, level, direction, options)
            <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (buildingInstance) {
              <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">buildingInstance</span> = buildingInstance
              <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">grassMesh</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(buildingInstance)
            }
          }
     }
</code></pre>
<p>这里出现的<code>createBuilding</code> 实际上时一个选择类工厂，会根据传入的<code>type</code>判断当前应该由那个具体建筑类进行后续实例化.</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILDING_CLASS_MAP</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">house</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">House</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">house2</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">House2</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">factory</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Factory</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">shop</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Shop</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">office</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Office</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">park</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Park</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">police</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Police</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">hospital</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Hospital</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">road</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Road</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">chemistry_factory</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">ChemistryFactory</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">nuke_factory</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">NukeFactory</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">fire_station</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">FireStation</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">sun_power</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">SunPower</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">water_tower</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">WaterTower</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">wind_power</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">WindPower</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">garbage_station</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">GarbageStation</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">hero_park</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">HeroPark</span>,
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 其他建筑类型可在此扩展</span>
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">createBuilding</span>(<span class="hljs-params">type, level = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, direction = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, options = {}</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cls</span> = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILDING_CLASS_MAP</span>[type]
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title class_">Cls</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cls</span>(type, level, direction, options)
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/023647ba832941b7b41f3e160204a28d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=17FCAXZuyVfXID11%2Fie7pv0%2BZF0%3D" alt="12.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>到这里就可以将 <code>Metadata</code>转换为 <code>3D</code>场景了。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>在Metadata 0-0 上填写建筑信息，刷新后效果如下</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/cf5437b9ee6b4787a0a9864f9fd515b2~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=GQmiFFYoXhvQFWt912IBw6D193w%3D" alt="09.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">3.交互系统：模式驱动 + 射线拾取</h3>
<p>首先提到交互系统我们需要填上之前提到的一个坑，就是<code>Tile</code>实体类继承的 <code>SimObject</code>到底起到什么作用？为什么不直接继承 <code>Object3D</code>?</p>
<p>事实是如果你仔细观察游戏界，当用户指向某块地皮时地皮会显示出特殊的互动效果，建造模式下可建区域为绿色（不可建为绿色）、拆除模式（DEMOLISH) 下所选区域为红色、迁移模式下为蓝色。</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/4e0d7fd286c043ff8d94b15a69e227e4~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=564KR%2B9xCFARkWUWdvlFfUPEFUg%3D" alt="10.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>但是<code>Tile</code> &amp; <code>Building</code>类组件却没有相应实现的代码。</p>
<p>相信到这里你也想到这 <strong><code>SimObject</code>类的作用：承担<code>Scene</code>里，交互对象的“行为”与“表现”。</strong></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-15">3.1 SimObject 在交互系统中的作用与原理</h4>
<p>SimObject 作为所有可交互物体的基类（继承 THREE.Object3D），统一封装了：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>mesh 材质克隆（避免共享材质被串改）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>选中/聚焦高亮（按模式映射不同颜色与透明度）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>动画反馈（gsap 轻量的 y 轴 yoyo 浮动）</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-16">mesh 材质克隆</h5>
<p><strong>mesh 初始化：克隆 GLTF，遍历所有子节点克隆材质并开启透明；将 userData 指向自身实例，便于射线命中后反查 Tile/Building</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// SimObject 互动基类，所有可交互对象继承自此类</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">SimObject</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_ inherited__">THREE.Object3D</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">/** <span class="hljs-doctag">@type</span> {<span class="hljs-type">THREE.Mesh?</span>} */</span>
  #mesh = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">/** <span class="hljs-doctag">@type</span> {<span class="hljs-type">THREE.Vector3</span>} */</span>
  #worldPos = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector3</span>()

  <span class="hljs-comment">/**
   * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">number</span>} x 对象的 x 坐标
   * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">number</span>} y 对象的 y 坐标
   * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">object</span>} resource 可选，threejs 资源对象（如 gltf 加载结果）
   */</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, y = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, resource = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">super</span>()
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'SimObject'</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> = x
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">z</span> = y
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果传入资源，自动初始化 mesh</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (resource) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mesh = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">initMeshFromResource</span>(resource)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (mesh) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setMesh</span>(mesh)
      }
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">/**
   * 从 threejs 资源对象（如 gltf 加载结果）初始化 mesh，并克隆材质
   * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">object</span>} <span class="hljs-variable">resource</span> - threejs 资源对象，需包含 scene 属性
   * <span class="hljs-doctag">@returns</span> {<span class="hljs-type">THREE.Object3D|null</span>}
   */</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">initMeshFromResource</span>(<span class="hljs-params">resource</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!resource || !resource.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 克隆模型</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mesh = resource.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">clone</span>()
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 遍历所有子节点，克隆材质并设置透明，userData 指向自身</span>
    mesh.<span class="hljs-title function_">traverse</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">child</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      child.<span class="hljs-property">userData</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (child <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Mesh</span> &amp;&amp; child.<span class="hljs-property">material</span>) {
        child.<span class="hljs-property">receiveShadow</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
        child.<span class="hljs-property">castShadow</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
        child.<span class="hljs-property">material</span> = child.<span class="hljs-property">material</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">clone</span>()
        child.<span class="hljs-property">material</span>.<span class="hljs-property">transparent</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
      }
    })
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> mesh
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>因为**<code>mesh.clone()</code> 默认会“共享”材质引用（以及几何体引用）**。也就是说，<code>clone()</code> 并不会对 <code>material</code> 做深拷贝；你改了任意一个克隆体的 <code>material</code>（比如改 <code>color</code>），所有共享同一 <code>material</code> 的 mesh 都会一起变化。</p>
<p>如果不对材质进行<code>clone</code>。在后续修改材质时则会出现以下情况：</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d1e4b8a7fa4341b7a89473939b198c02~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=4qHTAuvMo6JHRpDDM6kKZiVj29Y%3D" alt="11.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<h5 data-id="heading-17">选中/聚焦高亮（按模式映射不同颜色与透明度）+ 动画反馈</h5>
<p>实现高亮的代码并不难，只是简单的更改被选择<code>mesh</code>的发光色 &amp; 透明度 ：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">  <span class="hljs-comment">// 设置 mesh 的发光色</span>
  #<span class="hljs-title function_">setMeshEmission</span>(<span class="hljs-params">color</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">traverse</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">obj</span> =&gt;</span> obj.<span class="hljs-property">material</span>?.<span class="hljs-property">emissive</span>?.<span class="hljs-title function_">setHex</span>(color))
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 设置 mesh 的透明度</span>
  #<span class="hljs-title function_">setMeshOpacity</span>(<span class="hljs-params">opacity</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">traverse</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">obj</span> =&gt;</span> obj.<span class="hljs-property">material</span> &amp;&amp; (obj.<span class="hljs-property">material</span>.<span class="hljs-property">opacity</span> = opacity))
  }

</code></pre>
<p><code>setFocused(value, mode)</code> 内部按模式映射发光色与透明度（建造/拆除/搬迁/选择/无效建造），并用 gsap 做轻微浮动，形成好的视觉反馈。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">  <span class="hljs-comment">/**
   * 设置聚焦高亮，根据当前操作模式调整颜色和透明度
   * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">boolean</span>} value 是否聚焦
   * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> {<span class="hljs-type">string</span>} mode 操作模式，可选：'select' | 'build' | 'relocate' | 'demolish'，默认为 'select'
   */</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">setFocused</span>(<span class="hljs-params">value, mode = <span class="hljs-string">'select'</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// mode 到颜色和透明度的映射</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> emissionColor = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">HIGHLIGHTED_COLOR</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> opacity = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">SIMOBJECT_SELECTED_OPACITY</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">switch</span> (mode) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'select'</span>:
        emissionColor = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">SELECTED_COLOR</span>
        opacity = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">SELECTED_COLOR_OPACITY</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'build'</span>:
        emissionColor = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILD_COLOR</span>
        opacity = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILD_COLOR_OPACITY</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'build-invalid'</span>:
        emissionColor = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILD_INVALID_COLOR</span>
        opacity = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILD_INVALID_COLOR_OPACITY</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'relocate'</span>:
        emissionColor = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">RELOCATE_COLOR</span>
        opacity = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">RELOCATE_COLOR_OPACITY</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'demolish'</span>:
        emissionColor = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DEMOLISH_COLOR</span>
        opacity = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">DEMOLISH_COLOR_OPACITY</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">default</span>:
        emissionColor = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">HIGHLIGHTED_COLOR</span>
        opacity = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">SIMOBJECT_SELECTED_OPACITY</span>
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (value) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.#<span class="hljs-title function_">setMeshEmission</span>(emissionColor)
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.#<span class="hljs-title function_">setMeshOpacity</span>(opacity)
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 使用gsap实现y轴yoyo动画</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 先停止可能已有动画</span>
        gsap.<span class="hljs-title function_">killTweensOf</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>)
        gsap.<span class="hljs-title function_">to</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>, {
          <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.13</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">duration</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.41</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">yoyo</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">repeat</span>: -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">ease</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'sine.inOut'</span>,
        })
      }
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 取消聚焦，恢复默认</span>
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.#<span class="hljs-title function_">setMeshEmission</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.#<span class="hljs-title function_">setMeshOpacity</span>(<span class="hljs-variable constant_">SIMOBJECT_DEFAULT_OPACITY</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 停止动画并复位y轴</span>
        gsap.<span class="hljs-title function_">killTweensOf</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>)
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 直接回到初始y（假设聚焦只加了0.1）</span>
        gsap.<span class="hljs-title function_">to</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>, { <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">duration</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.2</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">overwrite</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> })
      }
    }
  }
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-18">3.2 射线拾取：把鼠标落到正确的 Tile</h4>
<p>原理为用 iMouse.normalizedMouse（<code>iMouse</code>为该项目框架中提供当前<code>mouse</code>信息的专属类）+ Raycaster → 命中 city.root → 沿父链向上找到带有 userData 的 Tile 实例（或其子节点）。</p>
<p><strong>流程图</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/26bd2d2166fa412a83b5aebd6309d469~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=oHDb%2FTyEO2eYyLOhcYyM%2FpQIfhw%3D" alt="13.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>相信看这篇文章的您来说**<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fthreejs.org%2Fdocs%2F%23api%2Fen%2Fcore%2FRaycaster" target="_blank" title="https://threejs.org/docs/#api/en/core/Raycaster" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">射线检测</a>**，并不是一个值得去花费篇幅的知识点。</p>
<p>这里仅简单的说一下主要优化手段：<strong>限定射线检测对象为地皮</strong></p>
<p>首先在<strong>City.js</strong>构建地皮时，将 Tile 统一塞入一个单独的 <code>Three.Group</code>,之后射线检测对象只针对这个 <code>Group</code>，这样一来</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> x = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; x &lt; <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">size</span>; x++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> row = []
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> y = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; y &lt; <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">size</span>; y++) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 读取元数据</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tileMeta = meta[x]?.[y] || { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'grass'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">building</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> }
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tile = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Tile</span>(x, y, {
          <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">type</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">building</span>: tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">building</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">direction</span>: tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">direction</span> !== <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span> ? tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">direction</span> : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 传递建筑朝向</span>
          <span class="hljs-attr">level</span>: tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">level</span> !== <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span> ? tileMeta.<span class="hljs-property">level</span> : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 传递建筑等级</span>
        })
        row.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(tile)
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">root</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(tile) <span class="hljs-comment">//统一塞入一个单独的 Three.Group</span>
      }
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 随后让 group 居中</span>
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">meshes</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(row)
    }
</code></pre>
<p>然后对<code>Building</code>添加<code>mesh.raycast = () =&gt; {}</code>逻辑射线检测只作用在 <code>Tile </code>上:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Building</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_ inherited__">SimObject</span> {

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 初始化建筑模型</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">initModel</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> modelName = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.type}</span>_level<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.level}</span>`</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> modelResource = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resources</span>.<span class="hljs-property">items</span>[modelName]
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (modelResource &amp;&amp; modelResource.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mesh = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">initMeshFromResource</span>(modelResource)
      mesh.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
      mesh.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.8</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.8</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0.8</span>)
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 设置朝向</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> angle = (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">direction</span> % <span class="hljs-number">4</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">90</span>
      mesh.<span class="hljs-property">rotation</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">MathUtils</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">degToRad</span>(angle)
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 禁止建筑被选中</span>
	  mesh.<span class="hljs-property">raycast</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {}
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setMesh</span>(mesh)
    }
    <span class="hljs-comment">//...</span>
  }
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-19">3.3 模式驱动</h4>
<p>在本项目中，模式切换由鼠标/键盘事件监听驱动：事件触发后更新 Pinia 的管理的<strong>全局属性</strong>（如 currentMode，selectBuilding），而 Interactor 在每次点击时读取这些<strong>全局属性</strong>并分发到相应的交互处理流程。比如建造模式下<code>Interactor (BUILD)</code>则会执行建造模式下相应逻辑，而拆除模式下会执行 <code>Interactor (DEMOLISH)</code>另一套逻辑。这里我会通过<code>BUILD</code>模式 &amp; 拆除模式来粗略解释一下具体实现过程。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-20">3.3.1 建造（BUILD）模式</h5>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b1f299f1bd484d3c80b45745690eed06~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=ghvTD6L3dL8m%2FPPacPbT6j3Stk0%3D" alt="12.gif" loading="lazy">
**BUILD 模式下主要任务是把“选中的建筑类型”落到“合规地块”，并同步当前Scene  与 Metadata。**在上述GIF你可以观察到：</p>
<ol>
<li>用户可以在右侧建筑卡片栏选择不同的建筑来进行建造</li>
<li>路可以随意构建，但其余类型建筑只能在路边构建。即一块路的上下左右四个地块就是<strong>合规地块</strong>。</li>
</ol>
<p>流程图如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/c878296e68224b64936cd32debc91ae7~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=NgBuNiDHNGOMvyMIAzRT5vKTjTc%3D" alt="14.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>当用户在侧边栏点击建筑卡片后会在<code>Pinia</code>设定<code>SelectBuilding</code>的值</p>
<p><strong>侧边栏.vue</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">selectBuilding</span>(<span class="hljs-params">{ type, name, level = <span class="hljs-number">1</span> }</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 仅在 BUILD 模式下允许选中</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (currentMode.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'build'</span>)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (selectedBuilding.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>?.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === type &amp;&amp; selectedBuilding.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>?.<span class="hljs-property">level</span> === level)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
  gameState.<span class="hljs-title function_">setSelectedBuilding</span>({ type, level })
  gameState.<span class="hljs-title function_">addToast</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${t(<span class="hljs-string">'selectedIndicator.selected'</span>)}</span>: <span class="hljs-subst">${name[language.value]}</span>`</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'info'</span>)
}
</code></pre>
<p>随后当用户点击一个地块时则触发当前模式下对应的逻辑</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-title function_">_onClick</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">focused</span>)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mode = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentMode</span>

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 在特定模式下，单击即选中</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable constant_">PERSISTENT_HIGHLIGHT_MODES</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(mode))
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">_setSelected</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">focused</span>)

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 根据模式委托给对应的处理器</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">switch</span> (mode) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">MODES</span>.<span class="hljs-property">SELECT</span>:
      <span class="hljs-title function_">handleSelectMode</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">selected</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">MODES</span>.<span class="hljs-property">BUILD</span>:
      <span class="hljs-title function_">handleBuildMode</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">focused</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">MODES</span>.<span class="hljs-property">DEMOLISH</span>:
      <span class="hljs-title function_">handleDemolishMode</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">selected</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">MODES</span>.<span class="hljs-property">RELOCATE</span>:
      <span class="hljs-title function_">handleRelocateMode</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">selected</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">default</span>:
      <span class="hljs-title function_">handleDefaultMode</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">focused</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>在建造模式下，<code>Interactor</code>首先会利用<code>canPlaceBuilding</code>判断当前地皮是否满足建造条件</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">canPlaceBuilding</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x, y, buildingType, metadata</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!metadata?.[x]?.[y])
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 部分特殊建筑可随意建造</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable constant_">FREE_BUILDING_TYPES</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(buildingType))
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 其他建筑需相邻道路</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> dirs = [[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>], [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>], [<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], [-<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>]]
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [dx, dy] <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> dirs) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> nx = x + dx
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ny = y + dy
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (metadata[nx]?.[ny]?.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'ground'</span> &amp;&amp; metadata[nx]?.[ny]?.<span class="hljs-property">building</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'road'</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>如果满足则会在 <code>3D</code>端放置建筑并同步<code>Metadata</code>中相应的值</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleBuildMode</span>(<span class="hljs-params">ctx, tile</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buildingTypeToBuild = ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-property">selectedBuilding</span>?.<span class="hljs-property">type</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buildingLevelToBuild = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!tile)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { x, y } = tile
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> metadata = ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-property">metadata</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> canBuild = <span class="hljs-title function_">canPlaceBuilding</span>(x, y, buildingTypeToBuild, metadata)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!buildingTypeToBuild || !canBuild || tile.<span class="hljs-property">buildingInstance</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">showToast</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'error'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'无法在此处建造，请选择合规地块。'</span>)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 通过 Pinia 修改 metadata</span>
  ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setTile</span>(x, y, {
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'ground'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">building</span>: buildingTypeToBuild,
    <span class="hljs-attr">direction</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 可根据实际情况</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">level</span>: buildingLevelToBuild,
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 新增建筑详情</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">detail</span>: <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILDING_DATA</span>[buildingTypeToBuild]?.<span class="hljs-property">levels</span>[buildingLevelToBuild],
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 产出因子 可能因为某些因素而影响产出，比如人口、科技等</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">outputFactor</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
  })
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-property">credits</span> &lt; <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILDING_DATA</span>[buildingTypeToBuild]?.<span class="hljs-property">levels</span>[buildingLevelToBuild]?.<span class="hljs-property">cost</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">showToast</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'error'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'Insufficient funds, unable to build.'</span>)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
  }
  ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">updateCredits</span>(-<span class="hljs-variable constant_">BUILDING_DATA</span>[buildingTypeToBuild]?.<span class="hljs-property">levels</span>[buildingLevelToBuild]?.<span class="hljs-property">cost</span>)
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ...后续同步 Three.js 层刷新</span>
  tile.<span class="hljs-title function_">setBuilding</span>(buildingTypeToBuild, buildingLevelToBuild, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
  tile.<span class="hljs-title function_">setType</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'ground'</span>)
  <span class="hljs-title function_">updateAdjacentRoads</span>(tile, ctx.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">world</span>.<span class="hljs-property">city</span>)
  <span class="hljs-title function_">showBuildingPlacedToast</span>(buildingTypeToBuild, tile, buildingLevelToBuild, ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>)
}
</code></pre>
<p>其实在游戏中的四大模式中，<code>BUILD</code>模式是有别于其余三大模式的。因为 <code>BUILD</code>是在四大模式中唯一一个不需要确认二次意图的模式，玩家只需要选择建筑，然后建造即可。而其余模式都需要在操作时再让用户确认一遍是否执行此操作。以下我以拆除模式为例做一个粗略介绍：</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-21">3.3.2 拆除（DEMOLISH）模式</h5>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ed68b5f27ecf47498f2688b54ad58950~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=pAzwzTBeKF2EFPVh9SrnARx6IC0%3D" alt="13.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>流程图如下:</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/36ddfb2fc3bb43de90b651b94463a773~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=d20heOXQD%2Bi0D3Ar9FW8vf%2FAduY%3D" alt="15.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在用户切换为 <code>DEMOLISH</code>模式后点击想要删除的<code>Tile</code>时 <code>emit（发布者角色）</code>就会执行一次广播事件</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleDemolishMode</span>(<span class="hljs-params">ctx, tile</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!tile)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (tile.<span class="hljs-property">buildingInstance</span>) {
    eventBus.<span class="hljs-title function_">emit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'ui:confirm-action'</span>, {
      <span class="hljs-attr">action</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'demolish'</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">tileId</span>: tile.<span class="hljs-property">id</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">tileName</span>: tile.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> || <span class="hljs-string">''</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">buildingType</span>: tile.<span class="hljs-property">buildingInstance</span>.<span class="hljs-property">type</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">buildingLevel</span>: tile.<span class="hljs-property">buildingInstance</span>.<span class="hljs-property">level</span>,
    })
    ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setSelectedBuilding</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: tile.<span class="hljs-property">buildingInstance</span>.<span class="hljs-property">type</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">level</span>: tile.<span class="hljs-property">buildingInstance</span>.<span class="hljs-property">level</span> || <span class="hljs-number">1</span> })
    ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setSelectedPosition</span>(tile.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>)
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    tile.<span class="hljs-title function_">setType</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'grass'</span>)
    ctx.<span class="hljs-title function_">_clearSelection</span>()
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>随后相应的 <code>Vue Component</code>就会开始展示面板信息，一旦用户在这是发送了确定执行本次拆除行为，</p>
<p>那么相应的<code>Vue Component</code>就会发送<code>eventBus.emit('ui:action-confirmed', dialogData.value.action)</code>事件通知<code>Scene</code>层执行拆除逻辑</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">confirmDemolish</span>(<span class="hljs-params">ctx</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tile = ctx.<span class="hljs-property">selected</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> building = tile.<span class="hljs-property">buildingInstance</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (tile &amp;&amp; building) {
    ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setTile</span>(tile.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>, tile.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>, {
      <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'ground'</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">building</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">direction</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">level</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
    })
    tile.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeBuilding</span>()
    <span class="hljs-title function_">showBuildingRemovedToast</span>(building.<span class="hljs-property">type</span>, tile, building.<span class="hljs-property">level</span>, ctx.<span class="hljs-property">gameState</span>)
    <span class="hljs-title function_">updateAdjacentRoads</span>(tile, ctx.<span class="hljs-property">experience</span>.<span class="hljs-property">world</span>.<span class="hljs-property">city</span>)
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>这也是选择模式 (SELECT) 和 拆迁模式 (RELOCATION)二次确认的逻辑</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-22">4.戛然而止的文章</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-23">4.1 文章长讲的又浅？！怒</h4>
<p>那么关于建筑信息、相互作用计算 (<code>getEffectiveBuildingValue</code>) 的具体实现，广告牌特效，路面建筑更新，每一个展开都是不小的篇幅。限于篇幅和大家的阅读耐心（我知道技术长文看着累！），这篇文章显然无法像<strong>保姆级教程</strong>一样，把从 <code>npm install three</code> 敲下第一行命令开始，到最终部署上线的每一个步骤、每一行关键代码都掰开揉碎讲清楚。</p>
<p><code>CubeCity</code> 虽然是个“整活”项目，但麻雀虽小五脏俱全，涉及的知识点非常庞杂：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Three.js 核心：</strong> 场景、相机、渲染器、几何体、材质、纹理、光照（环境光、平行光）、轨道控制器、Raycaster 点击交互、GLTF 模型加载与优化、后期处理（OutlinePass 做高亮）等。</li>
<li><strong>Vue 生态：</strong> Vue 3 + Vite 项目结构、Pinia 状态管理、组件通信、动画过渡、响应式 UI 设计。</li>
<li><strong>游戏逻辑：</strong> 上面详述的 Metadata 设计、建筑数据配置、资源产出/消耗计算、升级/拆除/搬迁逻辑、建筑间相互作用（如住宅需要靠近道路）的实现。</li>
<li><strong>工具链：</strong> Blender 基础模型处理、纹理制作、背景音乐制作、Vercel 部署等。</li>
<li>**项目管理：**如何管理项目周期，如何借助<code>Linear MCP + Cursor</code>来<code>push</code>我这样一个懒人去完成项目</li>
</ol>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/a81f91fddefe4846813d8deeb2e4785d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=HB9ONB5HRHXZ1GeXM3oRM3O1aPU%3D" alt="16.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>**如果大家对这个“把 Threejs 当游戏引擎搞结果还真搞出来的活”具体是怎么一步步实现的感兴趣，觉得这种实战项目拆解有价值，请务必用点赞❤️ + 收藏⭐️告诉我！如果数量可观（比如破百？），我承诺会为 <code>CubeCity</code> 单开一个系列专栏。**我会尽量以每篇 3000-4000 字左右的体量（不占用大家太多时间）来讲述这个项目。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-24">4.2 回归初心：Three.js 与我的方向</h4>
<p>这已经是我用 Three.js 实现的<strong>第三个游戏项目</strong>了，是时候该停下了。</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/007852b159584ce9815f9726a81ccfc2~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5L2V6LSk:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761059484&amp;x-signature=1%2F6IHtQqo1%2FzFl5TSoQvQqEHDkk%3D" alt="16.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>写完 <code>CubeCity</code>，虽然过程很有趣也很有成就感（特别是被 Three.js 官推转发时！）但也让我更深刻地意识到一点：<strong>用 Three.js 深度开发复杂游戏逻辑，确实不是它的核心优势和最合适的场景。这种“硬刚”游戏逻辑的开发体验，相比使用专业引擎，效率和舒适度上还是有显著差距的。</strong> 游戏引擎 (Unity, Unreal, Godot, Cocos 等) 在实体组件系统 (ECS)、物理、动画状态机、资源管线、跨平台打包、编辑器工具链等方面提供了极其成熟和高效的解决方案，是专门为此而生的工具。<strong>专业的事，真的应该让专业的引擎来干。</strong>（说多了都是泪）</p>
<p><strong>因此，后续的创作方向，我会更聚焦于 Three.js 本身最闪耀的领域：创造令人惊艳的、交互式的 3D 视觉效果和体验，并将其应用于网站、数据可视化、产品展示、艺术装置等场景。</strong> 比如探索更酷炫的着色器效果、更流畅的动画交互、更创意的 3D UI、WebXR 体验，或者是将 Three.js 与 AI 生成内容结合的有趣尝试。这才是 Three.js 在 Web 生态中的独特魅力和不可替代性所在。期待能继续给大家带来视觉上的惊喜！</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-25">4.3 开源与面包</h4>
<p>看着 <code>CubeCity</code> 的 GitHub 仓库（<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FhexianWeb%2FCubeCity%25EF%25BC%2589" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/hexianWeb/CubeCity%EF%BC%89" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/hexianWeb/C…</a> Star 数慢慢增长，这种感觉真的很棒，是纯粹用爱发电的动力之一。开源的精神、技术的分享、社区的反馈，这些都让我觉得有价值。</p>
<p><strong>但是...</strong> (是的，总有个但是)</p>
<p>维护一个开源项目（即使像 <code>CubeCity</code> 这样自认为的“小玩具”），投入的时间、精力远超想象。写代码只是第一步，文档、Issue 答疑、可能的 Bug 修复、兼容性更新、依赖库升级、甚至 feature request... 这些都需要持续投入。同时，我也看到不少朋友（包括一些前辈）的建议：“你花这么多时间做这些，质量也不错，应该考虑商业化”、“可以弄个付费教程”、“接点定制需求吧”、“开源核心，高级功能收费”...</p>
<p>我理解这些建议的出发点，都是善意的，希望我的付出能得到更实际的回报，能走得更远。毕竟，头发不能白掉，电费网费也是钱。<strong>纯粹的“为爱发电”能持续多久？如何在热爱、分享与获得合理回报（或者说，至少覆盖成本，让自己能持续投入）之间找到平衡点？</strong> 这是我最近一直在纠结的问题。</p>
<p>收费？怕违背开源初心，也怕麻烦。完全免费？时间和精力的持续性又是个问号。接定制？又怕偏离了自己想做的方向...</p>
<p><strong>开源之路，道阻且长。面包与理想，如何兼得？或者说，是否真的能兼得？</strong> 我还没有完美的答案。也许屏幕前的你，有什么想法或建议？欢迎在评论区聊聊。你们的反馈和支持（无论是精神上的 Star 分享，还是物质上的咖啡），对我来说都<strong>真的很重要</strong>。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-26">5.最后的一些话</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-27">本专栏的愿景</h4>
<p>本专栏的愿景是通过分享 <code>Three.js</code> 的中高级应用和实战技巧，帮助开发者更好地将 <code>3D</code> 技术应用到实际项目中，打造令人印象深刻的 <code>Hero Section</code>。我们希望通过本专栏的内容，能够激发开发者的创造力，推动 <code>Web3D</code> 技术的普及和应用。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-28">加入社区，共同成长</h4>
<p>如果您对 <code>Threejs</code> 这个 <code>3D</code> 图像框架很感兴趣，或者您也深信未来国内会涌现越来越多 <code>3D</code> 设计风格的网站，欢迎加入 <strong><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Ficegl.cn%2F" target="_blank" title="https://icegl.cn/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">ice 图形学社区</a></strong>。这里是国内 Web 图形学最全的知识库，致力于打造一个全新的图形学生态体系！您可以在认证达人里找到我这个 <code>Threejs</code> 爱好者和其他大佬。</p>
<p>此外，如果您很喜欢 <code>Threejs </code>又在烦恼其原生开发的繁琐，那么我诚邀您尝试 <strong><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Ftresjs.org%2F" target="_blank" title="https://tresjs.org/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Tresjs</a></strong> 和 <strong><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.icegl.cn%2F" target="_blank" title="https://docs.icegl.cn/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">TvTjs</a></strong>, 他们都是基于 <code>Vue</code> 的 <code>Threejs</code> 框架。 <strong><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.icegl.cn%2F" target="_blank" title="https://docs.icegl.cn/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">TvTjs</a></strong> 也为您提供了大量的可使用案例，并且拥有较为活跃的开发社区，在这里你能碰到志同道合的朋友一起做开源！</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-29">6.往期回顾</h3>
